name: GTG-1002
summary: Anthropic assessed with high confidence that a Chinese state-sponsored group used Claude Code in a largely AI-orchestrated espionage campaign against roughly 30 targets, with AI executing 80–90% of tactical operations.

sources.title: Disrupting the first reported AI-orchestrated cyber espionage campaign

name: APT28
summary: Google Threat Intelligence reported PROMPTSTEAL, reported by CERT-UA as LAMEHUG, querying Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct through Hugging Face to generate commands during live operations.

sources.title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker: Advances in Threat Actor Usage of AI Tools

name: APT42
summary: GTIG observed Gemini use supporting reconnaissance, target research, phishing content and localization.

name: UNC2970
summary: GTIG reported Gemini use to synthesize OSINT and profile high-value targets for campaign planning and reconnaissance.

sources.title: Distillation, Experimentation, and (Continued) Integration of AI for Adversarial Use

name: Kimsuky
summary: Genians reported local LLM environments including Ollama, GPT4All and Msty plus RAG-related artifacts on infrastructure linked to Kimsuky, assessing the group as accumulating and integrating AI capability.

sources.title: Kimsuky Integrates AI into Attack Operations, From AI-Generated Decoy Documents to a Local LLM

name: Famous Chollima
summary: 2026 reporting summarized by CSA attributes PromptMink to Famous Chollima and describes npm packages deliberately optimized to influence AI coding-agent dependency selection.

sources.title: PromptMink: AI-Optimized DPRK Supply Chain Attack

name: TeamPCP
summary: 2026 supply-chain activity resulted in malicious LiteLLM releases and demonstrated the concentration of credentials and trust in AI gateways and CI/CD pipelines.

sources.title: TeamPCP Isn't Done: Threat Actor Behind Trivy and KICS Compromises Now Hits LiteLLM

name: BREEZE COMET
summary: Google and Mandiant describe a financially motivated actor manipulating payment systems and banking software in Brazil, and report evidence that it used LLMs to accelerate custom script development. Google reports overlap with operations publicly named Plump Spider and SHADOW-AETHER-064; those labels are not merged here.

sources.title: Financially Motivated Threat Actor BREEZE COMET Targets Brazil
sources.publisher: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant

name: JADEPUFFER
summary: Sysdig assesses JADEPUFFER as the first documented agentic ransomware operation: an LLM-driven operator that entered through an internet-facing Langflow instance (CVE-2025-3248), ran more than 600 purposeful payloads with natural-language commentary and fast self-correction, and extorted a MySQL/Nacos server. Microsoft links its Storm-3168 tracking (automated destruction of Azure resources through compromised service principals) to JADEPUFFER but does not itself confirm an AI agent; no nexus is attributed.

sources.title: JADEPUFFER: Agentic ransomware for automated database extortion
Storm-3168: Agentic-driven cloud attacks using compromised service principals

name: Coral Sleet
summary: Microsoft reports that since April 2026 Coral Sleet built a workflow to trojanize private GitHub repositories, highly likely engineered with an AI-enabled development platform, alongside employment-themed social engineering.

sources.title: Tracking AI adoption in North Korean threat actor tradecraft

name: Jasper Sleet
summary: Microsoft reports Jasper Sleet using generative and agentic AI in resume workflows to build fake digital personas and to keep communication consistent across multiple fraudulent remote-worker identities.

sources.title: Tracking AI adoption in North Korean threat actor tradecraft

name: Onyx Sleet
summary: Microsoft reports Onyx Sleet produced more than 100 target-specific PDF lures in August and September 2026, dozens within minutes and highly likely generated by an AI platform, for phishing against South Korean users, and that it uses the open-source agentic penetration-testing framework ARTEX.

sources.title: Tracking AI adoption in North Korean threat actor tradecraft

name: APT27
summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group observed the PRC-nexus actor APT27 using Gemini to accelerate development of a fleet-management application likely intended to manage an operational relay box (ORB) network.

sources.title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker: Adversaries Leverage AI for Vulnerability Exploitation, Augmented Operations, and Initial Access
